description: National U.S. inpatient hospital discharges and aggregate costs by principal diagnosis (CCSR category) and year, from AHRQ HCUP's published "Most Expensive Conditions by Payer" Statistical Brief series — e.g. heart failure, septicemia/sepsis, acute myocardial infarction, COVID-19, stroke (cerebral infarction). Returns the top-20 most expensive conditions nationally (or filtered to one condition) with discharge counts, aggregate cost, and mean cost per stay. Years available: 2022, 2017 (AHRQ has not published a 2021 edition of this cross-condition table as of 2026-10-21). Optionally filter by expected payer (Medicare, Medicaid, private insurance, self-pay) for 2022.

condition.description: Condition name (e.g. "heart failure", "sepsis", "stroke") or CCSR code (e.g. "CIR019") to filter to. Omit to get the full top-20 table for that year/payer.

payer.description: Expected payer to filter by. Only 2022 has per-payer tables; other years return the all-payer table regardless of this argument.

year.description: Statistical Brief edition year. One of: 2022, 2017. Defaults to 2022 (the most recent AHRQ has published).

name: condition_hospital_costs
title: Condition Hospital Costs
